title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 repository CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in repository CI)

core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, using Lean 4 proofs and independently checked DRUP unsatisfiability certificates.
verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18), plus non-vacuity 30-ray and 17-ray witnesses, are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4.35.0 without Mathlib and replayed across 6 independent kernels (lean, leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron) via lake comparator --paranoid in CI; larger pools rest on independently checked DRUP certificates. Upgraded to Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0 and Build Standard v1.1.0 in v1.1.0. Explicitly notes the general unrestricted minimal-KS problem remains open.
falsification_command: cd repos/kochen-specker-extremal-lab/lean && lake build && lake env lean KS/Audit.lean && lake comparator --config comparator.json --paranoid
